state-uniqueness-8ddbb05c.summary: Distinct quantum states are mutually exclusive and cannot coexist, while a given quantum state is perfectly identified with itself.

area-quantum-4d61f3aa.title: Area Quantum
area-quantum-4d61f3aa.summary: The total area is composed of discrete contributions, each related to the quantum angular momentum of fundamental constituents.

technical-relation-6e8c4608.title: Technical Relation (Lorentz Boosts and Relativistic Motion)
technical-relation-6e8c4608.summary: This equation shows that the 'rapidity' is the hyperbolic arctangent of the velocity as a fraction of the speed of light, serving as a more linear measure of relativistic speed.

vanishing-connection-5490b7f1.title: Vanishing Connection
vanishing-connection-5490b7f1.summary: In a flat spacetime, where gravity is absent, the paths of freely falling objects are straight lines, and the way we measure lengths and angles doesn't change from point to point.

polyakov-action-integral-539b1143.title: Polyakov Action Integral (Worldsheet)
polyakov-action-integral-539b1143.summary: This action integral quantifies the 'cost' of a string's journey through spacetime, favoring paths that minimize this cost, analogous to how a particle follows a path of least action.

gravitational-shift-law-139730b6.title: Gravitational Time Dilation
gravitational-shift-law-139730b6.summary: Clocks in a stronger gravitational field (closer to a massive object) run slower than clocks in a weaker gravitational field.

conservation-of-probability-identity-1-c.title: Probability Conservation Continuity Equation
conservation-of-probability-identity-1-c.summary: The rate at which the probability of finding a particle in a region changes is exactly equal to the net flow of probability current across its boundaries.

faddeev-popov-ghosts-identity-1-421d06bb.title: Faddeev-Popov Ghost Lagrangian
faddeev-popov-ghosts-identity-1-421d06bb.summary: To prevent double-counting of physically identical gauge configurations in quantum calculations, mathematical ghost fields are introduced that cancel out unphysical polarization states.

gauge-freedom-potentials-identity-1-06e9.title: Electromagnetic Gauge Transformation
gauge-freedom-potentials-identity-1-06e9.summary: We can add the gradient of any scalar function to the magnetic vector potential without changing the physical magnetic field.

inverse-square-law.title: Inverse-Square Law
inverse-square-law.summary: The strength of something emanating from a point source diminishes with the square of the distance because the same 'stuff' is spread over a larger and larger area as it moves away.

commutation-relations-generators-transla.title: Commutation Relation of Generators of Translations and Dilations
commutation-relations-generators-transla.summary: The fact that applying a translation then a dilation is not the same as applying a dilation then a translation, with the difference being proportional to the system's energy, highlights an intrinsic link between position-changing and size-changing operations in quantum mechanics.

canonical-momentum-principal-function.title: Canonical Momentum in terms of Principal Function
canonical-momentum-principal-function.summary: Canonical momentum is the rate of change of the system's total action with respect to its generalized position.

velocity-decomposition.title: Velocity Decomposition
velocity-decomposition.summary: The total velocity of an object is the sum of the average velocity of the system it belongs to and its own velocity relative to that average.

stress-energy-tensor.title: Stress-Energy Tensor
stress-energy-tensor.summary: This equation represents the total stress experienced by a system as a sum of isotropic pressure and other energy-momentum contributions.

electron-degeneracy-pressure-zero.title: Electron Degeneracy Pressure approaching zero
electron-degeneracy-pressure-zero.summary: As the adiabatic index approaches zero, the electron degeneracy pressure becomes almost entirely independent of density, indicating a state where internal pressure cannot effectively resist compression.

electric-dipole-moment-null.title: Electric Dipole Moment Null
electric-dipole-moment-null.summary: The system's charge distribution is perfectly balanced, meaning the effective centers of positive and negative charge coincide.

scale-factor-phi-spherical.title: Scale factor for the phi coordinate in spherical coordinates
scale-factor-phi-spherical.summary: The length increment along the azimuthal angle $\phi$ is proportional to the radial distance $r$ and the sine of the polar angle $\theta$.

canonical-momentum-electromagnetism.title: Canonical momentum in electromagnetism
canonical-momentum-electromagnetism.summary: Canonical momentum is the total momentum of a charged particle, including its kinetic momentum and an additional term accounting for its interaction with the electromagnetic vector potential.

non-relativistic-approximation-energy.title: Non-relativistic approximation of relativistic energy
non-relativistic-approximation-energy.summary: At low speeds, a particle's total energy is approximately its inherent rest energy plus its kinetic energy, which increases with the square of its velocity.

average-energy-per-degree-of-freedom-203.title: Average Energy Per Degree of Freedom
average-energy-per-degree-of-freedom-203.summary: In a warm system, every possible way a particle can move or vibrate holds, on average, the same small amount of energy, which is directly proportional to the temperature.

boltzmanns-constant-value-63bc62ab.title: Boltzmann's Constant Value
boltzmanns-constant-value-63bc62ab.summary: Boltzmann's constant converts temperature into units of energy.

kinetic-energy-of-a-single-particle-db05.title: Kinetic Energy of a Single Particle

unit-of-volumetric-charge-density-e19a81.title: Unit of Volumetric Charge Density
unit-of-volumetric-charge-density-e19a81.summary: This unit measures how densely electric charge is packed into a region of space.

equality-of-reduced-density-matrix-ranks.title: Equality of Reduced Density Matrix Ranks

standard-deviation-of-observable-b-1b105.title: Standard Deviation of an Observable
standard-deviation-of-observable-b-1b105.summary: The standard deviation of an observable measures the inherent 'fuzziness' or uncertainty in its value for a given quantum state.

electric-field-perpendicular-transformat.title: Lorentz Transformation of Perpendicular Electric Field
electric-field-perpendicular-transformat.summary: A moving observer sees a different electric field, which is a mix of the original electric and magnetic fields, because motion through a magnetic field creates an electric field.

combined-rest-mass-energy-of-two-particl.title: Combined Rest Mass Energy of Two Particles
